messages:
olivia: Packaging wants to chunk the airgap installer manifest into 64MB parts to improve transfer for slow/offline mirrors. Need quick signoff on transport retention window and signing flow.

raj: Clarify: per-chunk cosign signatures or a top-level manifest sig? per-chunk is safer but more complex for verification on customer's side.

kevin: per-chunk cosign. customers mirror chunks in order, verify each sig. We'll include an index.json with ordered list and overall sha256. index.json signed too.

release-bot: artifacts uploaded: s3://private-artifacts/installer/2026-03-12/chunks/ (manifest index + 8 chunks). checksums: sha256:abc123def4567890... .

emma: Ops ask about retention. Canary nodes need 7d retention; enterprise customers expect 30d. Proposal: internal handoff keep 7d, public delivery retain 30d. Thoughts?

raj: +1 to two-tier retention. Also, pin image refs in index.json to sha256 instead of tags. Example: "image": "registry.redwood/private-installer@sha256:deadbeefcafebabef00d..."

oncall-ops: Deploy window: 03/15 01:00-05:00 UTC for canary. Will run canary-group-1 (3 nodes) then 04:00 full release cutover. Need rollback plan: quick revert to previous index + restore images from archived mirror.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-group-1 @ 2026-03-15T01:30:00Z. Command: /deploy run canary-group-1 installer@2026-03-12 --manifest-index s3://private-artifacts/installer/2026-03-12/index.json

kevin: Rollback command (dry-run):
```
/deploy rollback canary-group-1 installer --to-manifest s3://private-artifacts/installer/2026-03-08/index.json --force
```
Tested locally, restores previous image pins and replays post-install hooks.

olivia: Release notes draft: "Private installer: manifest chunking added to improve airgap delivery resilience. Index.json contains per-chunk signatures and pinned image SHAs. Retention: canary 7d; customer delivery 30d. See runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/installer-chunking"

raj: +:thumbsup: I'll add details about cosign key rotation and verifier code snippet.

oncall-ops: Need a short blurb for customers about mirror proxy best-practices and allowed retry windows (30 retries with backoff). I'll attach to the release notes.

release-bot: Canaries passed: 3/3 checks green. Full rollout scheduled for 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z. Tagging: @emma @kevin @raj for final signoff.

emma: Signed off. Proceed with full rollout. :rocket:

kevin: Leaving one note: ensure transport retention policy is enforced by the offsite mirror (ttl metadata). I'll follow up with ops to confirm policy applied pre-cutover.

olivia: Great — action items: kevin to verify TTL, raj to update cosign verifier docs, oncall-ops to publish customer blurb, release-bot to kick full rollout at 04:00 UTC. Closing thread unless blockers.
